reason: Free listing with flyers loaded for me is fine, I'll take that, but I won't pay anything until there are real users and I have no time for another platform. On my margins a monthly fee gets cut unless it clearly fills the bar.
objection: I don't have time to manage another platform, and I'm not paying a monthly fee for views when I can't see it bring people through the door.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from my own venue's numbers that the app brought paying customers on music nights, with zero work from me, and a price under what one extra night of takings covers.
